Shockingly bad service, lazy waiters but nice food
Jan 2024 • Couples
We stopped by late evening for a bite to eat. Good menu, we opted for Thali and a beer. The beer never came despite asking the waiter twice then we until we spoke to the manager who was super apologetic. Our food arrived it was tasty and well presented. 
We noted that non European customers we’re getting served and priority over us, the waiter was more interested in eating his own meal than providing customer service. The washroom is upstairs, there are lots of signs that the stairs are slippery, I guess as people have fallen. It’s not because the stairs are slippery, the stairs are all different step height!
Loved the food, the service was appalling and discriminatory. There are plenty of other places to each there, we’ll not be back!

Exquisite Flavors and Affordable Dining: Chandni Chowk Restaurant - A Hidden Gem in Ho Chi Minh City
Oct 2023 • Family
My cousins and I had the pleasure of dining at Chandni Chowk during our stay in Ho Chi Minh City, and it turned out to be the culinary highlight of our Vietnam trip. This gem of an Indian restaurant exceeded our expectations in every way.

The flavors in every dish were exquisite, delivering an authentic taste of India that left us craving more. What made the experience even better was the reasonable pricing, especially compared to other restaurants in the area.

From lunch to dinner, every meal was a delightful experience, and I can confidently say that Chandni Chowk is a must-visit for anyone seeking exceptional Indian cuisine in Vietnam. I wholeheartedly recommend this restaurant to fellow travelers and food enthusiasts alike.
